[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row disable_element="yes"][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="FEES STRUCTURE"]Tuition fee as fixed by the Government of Karnataka/ COMED- K for the academic year 2022-23 is as mentioned below:
  • Tuition fees for BE Students admitted through CET- Rs 71,874/- per year
  • Tuition fees for BE Students admitted through Comed-K- Rs 1,58,123/- per year
  • Other fees/University Fees payable at the time of admission for the academic year 2022-23 is as mentioned below:
Admission through CET- Rs 45,610/- per year
  • Other fees - Rs 20,000/- pre year
  • Skill lab fees - 15,000/- pre year
  • University Registration fees - 10,610/- per year
Admission through Comed-K- Rs 45,610/- per year
  • Other fees - Rs 20,000/- pre year
  • Skill lab fees - 15,000/- pre year
  • University Registration fees - 10,610/- per year
Transportation Fees
  • Stage 1- Rs 26,000/-
  • Stage 2- Rs 25,000/-
  • Stage 3- Rs 24,000/-
  • Stage 4- Rs 28,000/-Outside Mysuru)
